title: 第二十三章 进沟先找名字第二十四章 半煞少年
slug: 坟头开铺我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
lines: 乱葬沟外没有路。
只有一条被野草压出来的泥道，弯弯扭扭通向沟底。几只乌鸦停在枯树上，见人来了，也不飞，只歪着脑袋看。
糖糕站在沈清萝肩上，尾巴贴着她后颈。
“野狗都不进。”
沈清萝问：“你怎么知道？”
糖糕抬了抬下巴。
沟外有半只死兔，旁边是野狗脚印。脚印到沟口就断了，像那野狗宁愿饿着，也不肯再往里走一步。
燕不归挥手，两个缉违堂役吏上前封住沟口。
“先封沟。”
沈清萝蹲下，看沟边倒插的骨牌。
“先别封死。”
燕不归皱眉：“阵气在动。封晚了，里面的东西跑出来，你负责？”
“封早了，里面没名字的魂全碎，你负责？”
两人对视片刻。
谢无咎站在一旁，冷声道：“沟底有血煞阵。先压阵，再找人。”
沈清萝没抬头。
“先找名字。”
“沈清萝。”
“你吼我也没用。”她用桃木剑拨开一块骨牌底下的泥，“没名字，魂叫不回来。你一压，压下去的是阵，也是他们。”
谢无咎看着沟底。
“有时候，舍几个，比全要强。”
沈清萝终于抬头。
“你在幽冥渊舍惯了。可我守的是墓，不是乱坟岗。”话说出口，沟边忽然静了。
这话有点重。
阿青小心看了谢无咎一眼。
谢无咎脸色冷得厉害，却没有发作。
沈清萝也知道重了。
她把视线收回来，声音低了半分：“先找名字。找不到，我再听你的压。”
谢无咎沉默片刻，抬手。
黑煞沿着沟边铺开，没有往魂心里压，只挡住外头阴风倒灌。
“半炷香。”
沈清萝点头。
燕不归看着两人，低声对役吏道：“封外围，别碰骨牌。”
铁柱已经蹲在第一块骨牌前。
“第一块，无名。”
他抱着账本，一块一块编号。
“第二块，无名。第三块……烧过。”
糖糕鼻尖贴近那块骨牌，闻了一下，立刻打了个喷嚏。
“小孩味。哭过，没吃饱。”
阿青绕到另一边，听着沟底传来的细声。
“东边有两个，西边一个。还有一个在下面压着，不让别的小鬼靠近。”
沈清萝把七枚铜钱依次压在烧过的骨牌旁。
三十六块骨牌，七块被清虚符灰烧过。
content_en:
There is no road outside the mass grave trench.
There was only a mud path pressed out by weeds, twisting and turning, leading to the bottom of the ditch. A few crows sat on the dead trees. When they saw people coming, they did not fly and only tilted their heads to look.
Tanggai stood on Shen Qingluo's shoulders, his tail touching the back of her neck.
"No wild dogs will come in."
Shen Qingluo asked: "How do you know?"
Tang Cake raised her chin.
There was half a dead rabbit outside the ditch, and next to it were wild dog footprints. The footprints were broken when they reached the mouth of the ditch, like that wild dog who would rather go hungry than take another step inside.
Yan Bugui waved his hand, and two officials from the anti-violation hall stepped forward to seal the mouth of the ditch.
"Seal the trench first."
Shen Qingluo squatted down and looked at the dominoes inserted upside down by the ditch.
"Don't seal it yet."
Yan Bugui frowned: "The formation is moving. It's too late to close the door. If the things inside escape, are you responsible?"
"It's too late. The nameless soul inside is completely shattered. Are you responsible?"
The two looked at each other for a moment.
Xie Wujiu stood aside and said in a cold voice: "There is a bloody formation at the bottom of the ditch. Defeat the formation first, and then find people."
Shen Qingluo didn't look up.
"Find the name first."
"Shen Qingluo."
"It's no use yelling at me." She used her mahogany sword to push away the mud under a piece of domino. "It doesn't have a name, and the soul can't be called back. If you press it, it's the formation that will be pressed down, and they are also them."
Xie Wujiu looked at the bottom of the ditch.
“Sometimes, it’s better to lose a few than to have them all.”
Shen Qingluo finally looked up.
"You're used to living in the Netherworld. But I'm guarding the tomb, not the mass graves." As he spoke, the ditch suddenly became quiet.
This is a bit strong.
Ah Qing glanced at Xie Wu Jiu carefully.
Xie Wujiu's face was extremely cold, but he didn't have an attack.
Shen Qingluo also knew it was heavy.
She looked back and lowered her voice by half a minute: "Look for the name first. If you can't find it, I'll listen to your pressure."
Xie Wujiu was silent for a moment and raised his hand.
The black evil spread out along the edge of the ditch, not pressing into the heart of the soul, but only blocking the intrusion of the cold wind from outside.
"Half a stick of incense."
Shen Qingluo nodded.
"Enough."
Yan Bugui looked at the two men and whispered to the servant: "Seal the perimeter and don't touch the dominoes."
Tie Zhu was already squatting in front of the first domino.
"The first piece, nameless."
He held the ledger and numbered each piece.
"The second piece is nameless. The third piece... was burned."
Tang Cake put his nose close to the domino, smelled it, and immediately sneezed.
"It tastes like a child. I cried and I didn't eat enough."
Ah Qing walked around to the other side and listened to the soft sounds coming from the bottom of the ditch.
"There are two on the east side and one on the west side. There is another one pressing down below to prevent other imps from getting close."
Shen Qingluo pressed the seven copper coins next to the burned dominoes one by one.
There are thirty-six dominoes, seven of which have been burnt by the ashes of the Qingxu Talisman.
title_en: Chapter 23: Find the name first when entering the ditch Chapter 24: The half evil boy
